mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative equity market reaction due to reduced corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (industrial production below its 12-month moving average), persistent supply bottlenecks reduce corporate profitability and increase inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 12mo_MA.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1600.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential construction sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market deterioration, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (federal funds rate rising by more than 0.25 percentage points over three months), the immediate market reaction to rate hikes is negative equity returns due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a significant supply-side contraction, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.
